title: NVlabs/GR00T-WholeBodyControl
abstract:
Welcome to GR00T Whole-Body Control (WBC)! This is a unified platform for developing and deploying advanced humanoid controllers. This includes: Decoupled WBC models used in NVIDIA Isaac-Gr00t, Gr00t N1.5 and N1.6 and GEAR-SONIC

[ ](LICENSE) [ ](https://github.com/isaac-sim/IsaacLab/releases/tag/v2.3.2) [ ](https://nvlabs.github.io/GR00T-WholeBodyControl/) [ ](https://nvlabs.github.io/GEAR-SONIC/demo.html) --- # GR00T-WholeBodyControl This is the codebase for the **GR00T Whole-Body Control (WBC)** projects. It hosts model checkpoints and scripts for training, evaluating, and deploying advanced whole-body controllers for humanoid robots. We currently support: - **Decoupled WBC**: the decoupled controller (RL for lower body, and IK for upper body) used in NVIDIA GR00T [N1.5](https://research.nvidia.com/labs/gear/gr00t-n1_5/) and [N1.6](https://research.nvidia.com/labs/gear/gr00t-n1_6/) models; - **GEAR-SONIC Series**: our latest iteration of generalist humanoid whole-body controllers (see our [whitepaper](https://nvlabs.github.io/GEAR-SONIC/)); - **MotionBricks**: a real-time latent generative model for interactive motion control in animation and robotics (see the [project page](https://nvlabs.github.io/motionbricks/)). ## News - **[2026-08-31]** **SONIC deployment update** — added per-motor Kp/Kd scaling to reduce stumbling. - **[2026-07-23]** **SONIC v1.1 checkpoint** — released a robot-heading-normalized SONIC controller trained with wrist-pose augmentation for whole-body teleoperation and SONIC-backed VLA execution. See the [Model Card](#model-card) and [Download Models](https://nvlabs.github.io/GR00T-WholeBodyControl/getting_started/download_models.html#sonic-v11-checkpoint). - **[06/16]** **Isaac Teleop Setup (CloudXR / DeviceIO, in-process)** — added bring-up docs for the in-process CloudXR path via `isaacteleop[cloudxr]`, with no separate publisher container. See [Isaac Teleop Setup](https://nvlabs.github.io/GR00T-WholeBodyControl/tutorials/isaac_teleop_publisher_setup.html). - **[2026-06-16]** **Low-latency teleoperation checkpoint** — released a SONIC checkpoint with 4-frame SMPL reference lookahead for more responsive whole-body teleoperation. >[!abstract] 一句话总结：提出 GR00T Whole-Body Control (WBC) 统一平台，支持解耦 WBC（RL 控制下半身 + IK 控制上半身）、GEAR-SONIC 系列通用人形全身控制器和 MotionBricks 运动生成模型，并提供模型权重、训练与评估脚本。


# 一、动机

> 现有的人形机器人全身控制缺乏统一的开发与部署平台，且面向通用任务的全身控制器在训练、评估和部署上尚未形成完整体系。


# 二、方法

> 提出 GR00T Whole-Body Control (WBC) 统一平台，支持解耦 WBC（RL 控制下半身 + IK 控制上半身）、GEAR-SONIC 系列通用人形全身控制器和 MotionBricks 运动生成模型，并提供模型权重、训练与评估脚本。


# 三、核心实验结果

> 暂无定量实验数据；仓库发布了 SONIC v1.1、低延迟遥操作检查点（4 帧 SMPL 前瞻）等模型，并支持 NVIDIA GR00T N1.5/N1.6 中的解耦控制器。


# 四、对我的启发

> 与课题直接相关。该平台将强化学习与逆运动学解耦、引入生成式运动控制的思想，以及版本化模型发布方式，可作为人形机器人全身控制研究的基础与参考。
